name: spur-gears
why: The seeded gear pair: module 2, 20 and 30 teeth at 50 mm centres, each tooth thinned 0.1 mm at the pitch circle and the wheel turned half a tooth so a space faces the pinion's tooth. Involute flanks in mesh are parallel along the line of action, so the gap between them is the same at every tooth pair in contact: half the 0.2 mm circumferential play, times cos 20 - 0.0940 mm, which between_bodies reads on the exact solids. Tip to root is 0.25 * module = 0.5 mm, far wider, so the flanks set the clearance. Every flank is certified by the script to its involute.
